बकुल: बकुल MIMUSOPS ELENGI LINN.; M. ELENGI without an author's name de-signates M. ELENGI LINN. or two other species: a) SIDEROXYLON TOMENTOSUM ROXB. = M. ELENGI WIGHT; b) LABRAMIA BOJERI A.DC. = M. ELENGI SIEBER EX A.DC.
बदर: बदर (1) ZIZYPHUS JUJUBA LAM. (Ainslie 2, p. 94-96; Avk; Bpn, p. 563-564; Chopra; Dutt, = कोल; DWH 1, p. 350; Gul; HK, = कोल; KB 1, p. 589-591; MW; Nadk. 1, nr. 2662; PW; V 7, p. 97; Vśs: = घोण्टाबदर; Wise); (2) Z. SATIVA GAERTN. (DWH 1, p. 350; Na 1, nr. 110: राजबदर; V 1, p. 163: सौवीरबदर) = Z. VULGARIS LAM. (same sources); (3) Z. OENOPLIA MILL. (Nadk. 1, nr. 2662) = Z. SCANDENS ROXB. (Wise); (4) Z. ROTUNDIFOLIA LAM. = Z. NUMMULARIA WIGHT ET ARN. (भूबदरी: Chopra; KB 1, p. 592-593; V 4, p. 109) = Z. MICRO-PHYLLA ROXB. (KB 1, p. 592); incorrect is [Z. LACCIFERA] (Nadk. 1, nr. 2662); (5) = कार्पासी (KB 1, p. 344-346; PW; Vśs); (6) = कपिकच्छु (KB 1, p. 778-780; PW; Vśs); (7) = देवसर्षप (MW: a tree; PW: a kind of mustard); see Vśs about a number of different identifications of देवसर्षप।
बर्बर: बर्बर (1) OCIMUM BASILICUM LINN. (Dutt; KB 3, p. 1963; Sanyal) [= O. PILOSUM LINN.] (Dutt) = O. PILOSUM WILLD.; (2) O. GRATISSIMUM LINN. (DWH 3, p. 85-86; Sanyal); (3) a) a kind of Ocimum (PW); b) the dark type of अर्जक (Vśs); c) वैजयन्तीतुलसी (Vśs, unidentified); d) = बर्बरीक = अजगन्धिका: a kind of Ocimum (PW); (4) CLERODENDRUM SERRATUM SPRENG. (KB 3, p. 1948-1949); (5) C. SIPHONANTHUS [R. BR. IN] AIT. (MW; PW); (6) GYNANDROPSIS PENTAPHYLLA DC. = CLEOME PENTAPHYLLA LINN. (MW; PW); (7) CLEOME VISCOSA LINN. (KB 1, p. 183-185); (8) ACACIA ARABICA WILLD. (Nadk. 1, nr. 12) = MIMOSA ARABICA LAM. (Roxb., p. 421); (9) A. FERRUGINEA DC. (Nadk. 1, nr. 12); (10) A. LEUCOPHLOEA WILLD. (KB 2, p. 924-925: श्वेतबर्बर); (11) = पीतचन्दन (see चन्दन) (PW; Vśs); (12) a partic. fragrant plant (MW); (13) [unguis odoratus] (MW; PW: = व्याघ्रनख: a) possibly ὀνυξ of Dioscorides, unguis odoratus; see Dietz, p. 57; b) EUPHORBIA ANTIQUORUM LINN. = TITHYMALUS ANTIQUORUM MOENCH.).
बर्बरचन्दन: बर्बरचन्दन Dn, वर्ग 3, 9: बर्बरिक is a white, odourless type of चन्दन; Rn, वर्ग, 12, 17: बर्बरक, (also called) white बर्बरक, is (a kind of चन्दन that is) fragrant; a synonym (see Dn and Rn) is बर्बरोत्थ, explained in PW as white sandalwood.
बर्बरिका: बर्बरिका Is not recorded in the dictionaries; see वनबर्बरिका।
बर्बरी: बर्बरी (1) a) OCIMUM BASILICUM LINN. (Avk; Bpn, p. 511-512; KB 3, p. 1961-1964) [= O. BASILICUM VAR. THYRSIFLORA BENTH.] (Avk); see Hooker 4, p. 608; b) a kind of Ocimum, = बर्बर (MW; PW); c) Bpn, p. 511: = पर्णास; three types are distinguished: a) black: कुठेरक, b) white: अर्जक, c) with leaves like वट: वटपत्र; (2) ORTHOSIPHON GRANDIFLORUS BOLDINGH EX HEYNE (Bpn, p. 511-512). बाला (1) PAVONIA ODORATA WILLD. (Avk; Dutt; DWH 1, p. 224; HK; KB 1, p. 323-324; Nadk. 1, nr. 1822; V 6, p. 28); (2) HIBISCUS TORTUOSUS (Wise); there are two plants of this name in the Index Kewensis: a) H. TILIACEUS LINN. = H. TORTUOSUS ROXB.; b) H. TORTUOSUS WALL. EX PRAIN; (3) ELETTARIA CARDAMOMUM MATON (MW; PW; Vśs); (4) COCOS NUCIFERA LINN. (Vśs); (5) BARLERIA CRISTATA LINN. (Vśs, = नीलझिण्टी); (6) B. PRIONITIS LINN. (Vśs, = नीलझिण्टी); (7) = यूथी (Vśs); a number of species of Jasminum is called यूथी; see KB 2: a) J. HUMILE LINN. = J. BIGNONIACEUM WALL.; b) J. OFFICINALE LINN.; c) J. AURICULATUM VAHL; (8) = हरिद्रा (Vśs); (9) = पाठा (Vśs); (10) = आम्रातक (Vśs); (11) = कुमारी (Vśs); a number of species of Aloë, but esp. A. VERA LINN. = A. INDICA ROYLE, is called कुमारी or घृतकुमारी।
बिम्बी: बिम्बी COCCINIA INDICA WIGHT ET ARN. (Avk; Bpn, p. 674; Chopra; Dgv, nr. 167; Gul; HK; IRM 2, p. 257; Kav; KB 2, p. 1151-1154; Nadk. 1, nr. 534; Sanyal; V 2, p. 45) [= C. CORDIFOLIA (LINN.) COGN.] (Cho-pra; IRM 2, p. 257) = C. CORDIFOLIA COGN. (Nadk. 1, nr. 534) = CEPHALANDRA INDICA NAUD. (Avk; Chopra; DWH 2, p. 86-89; Dy, p. 351; Ghosh; HK; IRM 2, p. 257; KB 2, p. 1151-1154; Na 1, nr. 236; Nadk. 1, nr. 534; Sanyal; V 2, p. 45) = MOMORDICA MONADELPHA ROXB. (Avk; HK; Kav; KB 2, p. 1151-1154; MW; Nadk. 1, nr. 534; PW; Roxb., p. 696; Vśs; Wise) = BRYONIA CORDIFOLIA LINN.

MEDICA LINN. VAR. MEDICA] (Chopra; KB 1, p. 486-487; Watt CP, p. 325); c) [C. MEDICA LINN. VAR. ACIDA] (KB 1, p. 489-490); d) [C. ACIDA ROXB. VAR. 7] (Dutt, p. 127; DWH 1, p. 269); see about the varieties of C. MEDICA LINN.: Cooke 1, p. 200-201; Duthie 1, p. 131-132; Hooker 1, p. 514-515; see about the varieties of C. बीज: bīja = bījaka (see Ḍa. on Su. Ci. 25, 32: bījasāra = asanasāra, on Su.U. 10, 8: bījaḥ pītasāraḥ ‘bījaka’ iti yāvat).
बीजक: bījaka (1) = asana (Na 1, nr. 137; V. 1, p. 98; Dgv, nr. 109; Bpn, vaṭādivarga 28; Kai.Nigh., oṣadhivarga 811cd-812; Bt.) (see on asana and bījaka CD, p. 152-155 and DGV 2-3, p. 597-599); (2) = mātuluṅga = bījapūra (HK; V. 6, p. 21; Nś. 53-54).
